run_boilerplate_cleanup: run the boilerplate cleanup script to remove template text from a HuggingFace dataset and push it back to the hub
clean_text_function: create a function that removes boilerplate phrases like greetings and warnings from dataset text completions
add_boilerplate_pattern: add a new regex pattern to the boilerplate cleanup list to match additional template text
review_clean_text: review the clean_text function to understand how it strips boilerplate from dataset samples
summarize_patterns: summarize the regex patterns used to detect boilerplate text in alien stories, wikihow, and middle school datasets
